errors.agentAction: Re-run `alln docs <command>` and fix arguments.
errors.explain: The command was called with invalid or conflicting arguments. Consult the generated docs for the command and correct the invocation.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln dev export-contracts`, then rebuild.
errors.explain: Generated artifacts no longer match the registry. Regenerate and rebuild before relying on output.

errors.agentAction: Use one of flagship | balanced | fast.
errors.explain: The tier name was not one of flagship, balanced, or fast.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json` and pass a known model id.
errors.explain: The model id is not in the catalog, so it cannot be assigned to a tier. List models and use a real id.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln stalled list --all --json` and use a current episode id.
errors.explain: No stall episode matches the given id (it may have cleared). List stalled work and retry with a live episode id.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`.
errors.explain: A required doctor check failed. Inspect the structured report and address the named check, then retry.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; add/configure the missing source.
errors.explain: A required source CLI/runtime was not resolved on this machine. Install or locate it, then re-probe.

errors.agentAction: Re-authenticate the named source.
errors.explain: The source resolved but its authentication is invalid or expired. Sign in via the source's own login flow.

errors.agentAction: Open the provider app once, run its login command in Terminal, then `alln doctor --full --agent <source>`.
errors.explain: The source CLI could not read credentials from the macOS Keychain (SecItemCopyMatching failed). Common when Allnighter or the CLI is launched outside Terminal. Open the provider app, complete sign-in, then re-probe.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; pick an on-Bench ready model or enable one.
errors.explain: The requested model is not runnable: it may be off-Bench, its source may not be ready, or it may not exist. Use `alln models --json` to see available vs on-Bench vs ready state.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln team show --json`; fix unavailable workers.
errors.explain: The default team has no runnable workers. Inspect and repair the team lineup before running.

errors.agentAction: Inspect `workerId` and source error; failed worker remains visible.
errors.explain: One worker failed. The failure is shown, never hidden; other workers may still have answered. Retry the worker or proceed with partial results.

errors.agentAction: Retry with a ready plan writer or export worker answers.
errors.explain: The plan-writer stage failed. Retry with a ready plan writer, or export the worker answers and synthesize later.

errors.agentAction: Retry with lower effort or fewer workers.
errors.explain: The team run exceeded its time budget. Reduce effort or the worker count and retry.

errors.agentAction: Inspect failed workers and stages; retry or adjust the team.
errors.explain: The team run ended without a usable result (e.g. failed or cancelled). Inspect the failed workers/stages in the run, then retry or change the team.

errors.agentAction: Do not recursively spawn teams without explicit depth budget.
errors.explain: A worker tried to start another team run beyond the allowed depth. Set an explicit depth budget if nesting is intended.

errors.agentAction: Wait or retry after current team run completes.
errors.explain: The concurrency governor is at capacity. Wait for a slot and retry; this is a real busy state, not a fake queue.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; ensure Allnighter's support directory is writable, or set a writable support root for MCP/eval runs.
errors.explain: The team-run governor could not create, open, or lock its slot store. This is a storage/permission/configuration problem, not a capacity limit.

errors.agentAction: Keep item Draft/Pending; mutating pending runs are outside Pending M1.
errors.explain: Mutating pending runs are not enabled in this milestone. Keep the item Draft/Pending.

errors.agentAction: Keep order unchanged; reorder only Pending items in the same serialized group.
errors.explain: The requested Pending reorder was rejected because the item and anchor do not share the same serialized group.

errors.agentAction: Generate a new key or reuse the original payload.
errors.explain: The same idempotency key was reused with a different canonical payload. Use a new key or repeat the original request.

errors.agentAction: Poll team status using nextPollAfterMs, then call team result again.
errors.explain: The run is not terminal yet. Poll team status and retry team result when resultAvailable is true.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln history --json`.
errors.explain: No run matches the given id. List history and pick a valid run id or `latest`.

errors.agentAction: Use foreground CLI or start resident mode when available.
errors.explain: The resident coordinator is not running. Use a foreground command, or start resident mode when it is available.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln skills --lane <lane> --json` and pick a valid skill id.
errors.explain: No skill matches the given id. List skills for the lane and retry with a valid SkillID.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln teams --lane <lane> --json` and pick a valid team id.
errors.explain: No team matches the given id. List teams for the lane and retry with a valid TeamID.

errors.agentAction: Edit the team with `teams edit` instead; only delete an edited built-in (which restores the shipped version).
errors.explain: A built-in team that was never edited has nothing to delete. Edit it in place with `teams edit`, or use `teams restore` to revert prior edits.

errors.agentAction: Only built-in teams can be restored; for a custom team, edit or delete it instead.
errors.explain: Restore reverts a built-in team to its shipped version. A custom team has no shipped version to restore to.

errors.agentAction: Duplicate the built-in skill, then edit the custom copy.
errors.explain: Built-in skills cannot be edited or deleted. Duplicate to a custom skill and edit that copy.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different team id or delete the conflicting custom team.
errors.explain: A team with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different skill id or delete the conflicting custom skill.
errors.explain: A skill with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Fix the team definition and retry `alln teams edit`.
errors.explain: The team definition is invalid (missing rows, unknown skills, or bad effort/output kind).

errors.agentAction: Fix the skill definition and retry `alln skills edit`.
errors.explain: The skill definition is invalid (empty template, missing lane, or unknown purpose).

errors.agentAction: Set another default team before deleting or changing the lane default.
errors.explain: The default-team change would leave a lane without a valid default.

errors.agentAction: Remove the skill from team definitions before deleting.
errors.explain: The skill is still referenced by one or more team definitions.

errors.agentAction: Pick a skill from the same lane as the team.
errors.explain: A team row references a skill from another lane.

errors.agentAction: Use a canonical lowercase id matching the catalog rules.
errors.explain: The catalog id fails canonical ID rules.

errors.agentAction: Treat as implementation bug; run export-contracts check.
errors.explain: Output failed to match its declared schema. This is an implementation bug; run the export-contracts drift check.

errors.agentAction: Ask the user for the named permission.
errors.explain: The action needs a user-granted permission that is not present. Request the named permission before retrying.

errors.agentAction: Approve or configure the MCP client before retrying.
errors.explain: The calling MCP client is not approved. Approve or configure it, then retry.

errors.agentAction: Re-ingest or re-send the attachment; do not retry with stale bytes.
errors.explain: Attachment storedSha256 does not match on-disk bytes.

errors.agentAction: Use thread_get to list resolved attachments for the turn.
errors.explain: No attachment record exists for the requested id.

errors.agentAction: Remove attachments until within the count cap.
errors.explain: Too many images attached for one send.

errors.agentAction: Use a smaller image or fewer attachments.
errors.explain: An attachment exceeds byte or megapixel limits.

errors.agentAction: Send PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP only.
errors.explain: Attachment MIME type is not allowed.

errors.agentAction: Fix or replace the corrupt image file.
errors.explain: Image could not be decoded.

errors.agentAction: Fix the base64 payload.
errors.explain: MCP base64 image payload is invalid.

errors.agentAction: Check workingDir permissions and disk space.
errors.explain: Could not copy attachment into workspace mirror.

errors.agentAction: Add `.allnighter/` to gitignore or info/exclude manually.
errors.explain: Staged mirror but could not update git ignore rules.

errors.agentAction: Reduce message or attachment count; never silently trim current send.
errors.explain: Protected attachment block does not fit context cap.

errors.agentAction: Bind the thread to a project/working directory, then retry.
errors.explain: File references resolve against the Mac project root. The thread has no usable root.

errors.agentAction: Pick a path inside the project root.
errors.explain: The requested path escapes the enrolled project root, so Allnighter refused to read it.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the file picker or choose an existing project file.
errors.explain: The referenced file no longer exists at run time.

errors.agentAction: Check file permissions or choose another file.
errors.explain: The file exists but Allnighter could not read it as a regular file.

errors.agentAction: Reference text files only in v1.
errors.explain: File references v1 injects UTF-8 text. Binary files are not delivered.

errors.agentAction: Reference a smaller file or a line range.
errors.explain: The source file exceeds the v1 per-file read cap.

errors.agentAction: Remove file references until within the cap.
errors.explain: The send has more file references than v1 allows.

errors.agentAction: Do not attach secrets; summarize the needed config manually.
errors.explain: The path looks like credentials, keys, or an environment file and was blocked.

errors.agentAction: Choose a valid 1-based line range inside the file.
errors.explain: The requested line range is empty, reversed, or past the end of the file.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the reference and re-approve the changed file before running.
errors.explain: A delayed or pending send would read different bytes than the approved reference hash.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the Project file picker and retry.
errors.explain: The search catalog was stale. The resolver remains authoritative and did not deliver stale content.

errors.agentAction: Choose a worker that can receive referenced file text or use a chat worker.
errors.explain: The selected route cannot accept Project file references.

errors.agentAction: Use a new idempotency key or repeat the original payload.
errors.explain: Same idempotency key reused with a different thread send payload.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln history --json` (or create a thread); retry with a valid thread id.
errors.explain: No thread matches the given id, or no threads exist yet. List threads and retry with a valid thread id.

errors.agentAction: Re-run the Bug Hunt diagnosis; the fix attempt needs a typed fix packet.
errors.explain: The Bug Hunt answer run produced no typed fix packet (the writer emitted no fenced fix-packet block), so there is no hypothesis to try. Re-run the diagnosis with a sharper report.

errors.agentAction: Read the gate reason; resolve the danger flag / add an actionable hypothesis + proof, then retry.
errors.explain: The fix packet is not safe to execute: it carries a danger flag (credentials, deletion, deploy…), lacks an actionable hypothesis (a fix within a boundary), names no truth owner, or its proof method is incomplete. Danger blocks; doubt does not.

errors.agentAction: Pass --executor a single mutating team that is runnable on this bench (default execution_playbook).
errors.explain: The chosen fix executor is not a single, mutating, runnable team. The fix attempt must resolve to exactly one mutating worker.

errors.agentAction: Pass `packet` (inline JSON) or `packetPath` to a WorkSlicePacket file.
errors.explain: No typed work slice packet was provided or the file could not be parsed.

errors.agentAction: Fix the packet: remove danger flags, name intent, allowlist, and a complete check.
errors.explain: The slice packet failed the safety gate (danger, missing allowlist, incomplete check, etc.).

errors.agentAction: Run `alln team show --json`; pick a single mutating runnable team for --executor.
errors.explain: The executor team is missing, not mutating, not runnable, or does not resolve to exactly one worker.

errors.agentAction: Install/start OpenCode serve or pick a non-opencode executor.
errors.explain: The OpenCode serve coordinator could not start or pass health check for an opencode executor.

errors.agentAction: Inspect the error detail; retry the send or fix the worker.
errors.explain: The thread send did not complete (worker or transport failure). Inspect the detail, then retry.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json` and retry with a valid model id.
errors.explain: No model matches the given id. List models and retry with a valid ModelID.

errors.agentAction: Duplicate the built-in model, then edit the custom copy.
errors.explain: Built-in models cannot be edited or deleted. Duplicate to a custom model and edit that copy.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different model id or delete the conflicting custom model.
errors.explain: A model with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Fix the model definition and retry the edit.
errors.explain: The model definition or id is invalid (bad id, missing fields, or unknown driver mapping).

errors.agentAction: Reference a known driver id, or add the driver manifest first.
errors.explain: The model references a driver that is not registered. Use a known driver id or add its manifest.

errors.agentAction: Capture the message and `traceId`; retry once, then report if it persists.
errors.explain: An unexpected internal failure occurred (not a usage error). The detail is in the message; this is a defensive catch-all, not a routine condition.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln project list --json`; retry with a valid id or name.
errors.explain: No project matches the given id or name. List projects and retry with a valid identifier.

errors.agentAction: Select or add a project, then re-run the mutating action.
errors.explain: A mutating action was attempted with no project selected. Mutating work is always scoped to one project root.

errors.agentAction: Use the existing project that owns this normalized root.
errors.explain: The path resolves to an existing project's normalized root; the existing project is returned rather than a duplicate.

errors.agentAction: Restore the folder/permissions, then `alln project show <id>` to re-observe.
errors.explain: The project root is missing or permission-denied (rootState != available); mutating runs are blocked until the root is restored.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln project unarchive <id>` before new runs.
errors.explain: The project is archived. Unarchive it before starting new runs; reads remain available.

errors.agentAction: Assign the thread/pending item to a project, then retry.
errors.explain: The thread or pending item has no project. Assign it to a project before a mutating run.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln project workers <id> --json`; open the CLI in the project folder and complete its trust/login, then recheck.
errors.explain: The target worker's project readiness is not `ready` for this root. The run waits until the worker is ready here.

errors.agentAction: The active mutating run on this repo root looks stuck (the wait bound elapsed); wait for it to finish or stop it, then retry.
errors.explain: At most one mutating run per canonical repo root. A second mutating run normally QUEUES (FIFO) behind the active one and runs when it finishes; this error is the safety valve — it fires only when the active run is still holding the lock after the wait bound (it is wedged), so the queued run is refused instead of hanging forever.

errors.agentAction: Restore the project folder or pick an available project root, then retry.
errors.explain: The project repo root is missing or unreadable; runs require a real cwd in the repo.

errors.agentAction: Pick a ready worker or run setup health, then retry.
errors.explain: No runnable worker resolved for this run (missing CLI, wrong driver, or bench not ready).

errors.agentAction: Pick one execution source, run as non-mutating review/propose, or split into judgment then execution.
errors.explain: Mutating execution teams must resolve to one CLI driver. Mixed-source execution is blocked before spawn.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; use a known driver id in appliesTo.
errors.explain: The utilization source id is not registered on this bench.

errors.agentAction: Add the source to Boost window appliesTo, then retry.
errors.explain: The source is not included in the Boost window appliesTo list.

errors.agentAction: Sign in to the named CLI, then retry the seed.
errors.explain: The seed stopped on an auth prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms sign-in.

errors.agentAction: Resolve billing on the provider, then retry.
errors.explain: The seed stopped on a billing or quota prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms payment.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Router bootstrap — readiness, nextToolPlan, workflows, and contractHash (no tool roster or help sitemap).
USE WHEN: First call in a session or after a contract/auth change.
NOT WHEN: You need product how-to prose (use help) or deep machine diagnostics (use doctor).
NEXT: Follow nextToolPlan — typically team_start(dryRun:true), else doctor.
mcpTools.title: Hello

mcpTools.name: doctor

params.name: agent
params.summary: Limit to one source id (e.g. cursor_agent).

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Diagnostics report for sources, models, auth, coordinator, and Boost window readout.
USE WHEN: mcp_hello routes here, a run is blocked, or you need live machine health.
NOT WHEN: You only need one error code explained (use error_explain) or product docs (use help).
NEXT: error_explain on failed checks; then retry the blocked workflow.
mcpTools.title: Doctor

mcpTools.name: error_explain
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Explain one error/recovery code with cause, who fixes it, agentAction, and helpRef.
USE WHEN: A tool failed and you need structured recovery (also covers trimmed thread_send attachment/file codes).
NOT WHEN: You need live readiness (use doctor) or a full help topic (use help).
NEXT: Follow agentAction; re-call the tool that failed or use help(topic/error).
mcpTools.title: Explain error

mcpTools.name: help

params.name: tool
params.summary: Find the topic documenting this MCP tool.

params.name: error
params.summary: Find the topic for this error code.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Search or fetch installed Allnighter help — product how-to, tool choice, setup, safety.
USE WHEN: Any Allnighter usage question before answering from memory.
NOT WHEN: You need this machine's live state (use mcp_hello/doctor) or a run record (use run_get).
NEXT: Follow the returned next-tool plan; static topics also live at allnighter://help/{topic}.
SELECTOR: query → ranked search; topic|ref|tool|error → fetch one topic.
mcpTools.title: Help

mcpTools.name: defaults_get
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Read Default model settings — Auto tier, per-tier rosters, unassigned shelf, live resolution.
USE WHEN: Choosing a worker override or explaining what Auto resolves to right now.
NOT WHEN: You need per-project worker cache (use project_workers) or catalog teams (use teams_get).
NEXT: team_start(dryRun) or team_run with an explicit worker override.
mcpTools.title: Get defaults

mcpTools.name: history

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Search prior local team runs (read-only, zero quota).
USE WHEN: You need an old run id or to recall prior prompts/results.
NOT WHEN: You have a run id already (use run_get) or need live async status (use team_result).
NEXT: run_get with the chosen run id.
mcpTools.title: Search history

mcpTools.name: teams_get

params.name: teamId
params.summary: One team id — returns full summary (absorbs teams_show).

params.name: includeInactive
params.summary: Include inactive teams in list (default false).

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior list response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: List, show, or fetch round-trippable definitions for teams; no-arg also returns per-lane defaults.
USE WHEN: Discovering teams, inspecting one team, or exporting a TeamPreset for teams_edit(save).
NOT WHEN: Mutating catalog entries (use teams_edit) or running a team (use team_ask/team_run).
NEXT: teams_edit to save changes; team_start or team_ask to run.
MODE: teamId omitted → summary list (+ lane defaults); teamId present → full record; detail:definition → TeamPreset JSON.
mcpTools.title: Get teams

mcpTools.name: teams_edit
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: PATCH-dispatched team catalog mutations — save, duplicate, set default, delete, restore.
USE WHEN: Creating or updating custom teams or lane defaults.
NOT WHEN: Read-only inspection (use teams_get) or running a team (use team_ask/team_run).
NEXT: teams_get to verify; team_start(dryRun) before first run with a changed team.
ACTION: save → partial-merge definition; duplicate → copy; set_default → lane default; delete → remove custom/builtin edits; restore → shipped builtin.
mcpTools.title: Edit team

mcpTools.name: skills_get

params.name: skillId
params.summary: One skill id — returns full definition.

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior list response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: List lane-scoped skill summaries or fetch one skill including its template.
USE WHEN: Discovering skills or reading a template before skills_edit(save).
NOT WHEN: Mutating skills (use skills_edit) or running work (use team_ask/team_run).
NEXT: skills_edit to save; teams_get to see which skills a team uses.
MODE: skillId omitted → summary list; skillId present → full skill record (absorbs skills_show).
mcpTools.title: Get skills

mcpTools.name: skills_edit
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: PATCH-dispatched skill catalog mutations — save, duplicate, delete.
USE WHEN: Creating or updating custom skills.
NOT WHEN: Read-only inspection (use skills_get) or running work.
NEXT: skills_get to verify the saved skill.
ACTION: save → replace definition; duplicate → copy builtin; delete → remove custom skill.
mcpTools.title: Edit skill

mcpTools.name: team_ask

params.name: question
params.summary: The prompt to ask the team.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Run a lane answer team on a prompt; returns a board/synthesis. Never takes the write lock or execution lane.
USE WHEN: Parallel non-mutating judgment — options, review, design boards.
NOT WHEN: Repo-scoped mutating execution (use team_run) or async overnight runs (use team_start).
NEXT: run_get or history to retrieve the structured run; team_run only if the user explicitly executes one pick.
mcpTools.title: Ask team

mcpTools.name: team_run

params.name: project
params.summary: Project id, name, or repo path.

params.name: team
params.summary: Team preset id; omit for Default Team.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Project-scoped unified run — may dispatch one mutating worker under the execution lane write lock.
USE WHEN: The user wants code/design/copy changes applied in a repo root.
NOT WHEN: Non-mutating parallel options (use team_ask) or fire-and-forget async (use team_start).
NEXT: run_get for the finished run; project_context after a mutating run in the same project.
mcpTools.title: Run team

mcpTools.name: team_start

params.name: dryRun
params.summary: When true, preflight only — no run, no quota (absorbs team_preflight).

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Start an async team run (or validate with dryRun:true — absorbs team_preflight).
USE WHEN: Overnight/async fan-out where you poll team_result until terminal.
NOT WHEN: Synchronous answer (use team_ask) or project-scoped mutating execute (use team_run).
NEXT: team_result (poll); run_get when terminal; team_cancel to abort.
mcpTools.title: Start team run

mcpTools.name: team_result

params.name: detail
params.summary: summary | full (full embeds worker prompt snapshots).

params.name: includePrompts
params.summary: When true, embed worker prompt snapshots.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Poll async run state — running envelope with nextPollAfterMs, or terminal TeamRunJSON (absorbs team_status).
USE WHEN: After team_start, until status is terminal.
NOT WHEN: You already have a terminal run id and want audit/history shape only (use run_get).
NEXT: Poll again after nextPollAfterMs while running; run_get(view:summary) when done.
MODE: running → lightweight status; terminal → full TeamRunJSON (detail/full for prompt snapshots).
mcpTools.title: Get team result

mcpTools.name: team_cancel
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Cancel an active async team run.
USE WHEN: User abort or superseded work on a team_start run id.
NOT WHEN: The run is already terminal (use team_result/run_get to confirm).
NEXT: team_result to confirm cancelled terminal state.
mcpTools.title: Cancel team run

mcpTools.name: run_get

params.name: full
params.summary: For view:summary — include worker prompt snapshots.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Fetch one run by id/latest in summary, spec, or floor view (absorbs show, spec_get, floor_show).
USE WHEN: Inspecting a finished or historical run — workers, artifacts, floor, spec packet.
NOT WHEN: Polling a live async team_start run (use team_result).
NEXT: thread_get if the run owned a thread; pending_list if execute was deferred.
VIEW: summary → TeamRunJSON; spec → spec/result packet; floor → inspectable Floor run.
mcpTools.title: Get run

mcpTools.name: pair_run

params.name: project
params.summary: Project id, name, or repo path.

params.name: queueDir
params.summary: Directory of slice packets for queue mode (pair run).

params.name: packetPath
params.summary: Path to one WorkSlicePacket .json or markdown fence (single-slice mode).

params.name: until
params.summary: Hard stop clock HH:MM (local) for queue mode.

params.name: executorAttemptsBeforePlanner
params.summary: GLM attempts per packet before planner takeover (default 3).

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Run a durable slice queue unattended, or dispatch one inline slice packet (absorbs pair_slice).
USE WHEN: Sprint/pair-programming automation with gate → executor → repo check.
NOT WHEN: A single synchronous team_run suffices or you only need queue status (use pair_status).
NEXT: pair_status while running; run_get on child run ids.
MODE: queueDir → unattended queue; packet|packetPath → one bounded slice (absorbs pair_slice).
mcpTools.title: Run pair queue

mcpTools.name: pair_status

params.name: queueDir
params.summary: Directory containing queue.json and slice packets.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Read slice queue state — per-entry status, child run id, elapsed time, stall guidance.
USE WHEN: Monitoring an in-flight pair_run queue.
NOT WHEN: Starting or advancing the queue (use pair_run).
NEXT: pair_run to continue; run_get on the active child run id.
mcpTools.title: Pair queue status

mcpTools.name: thread_send

params.name: fileReferences
params.summary: Project file refs as paths or objects with path/startLine/endLine.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Send a message and/or images/file refs to a work thread worker.
USE WHEN: Continuing a project thread conversation with optional attachments.
NOT WHEN: Read-only thread inspection (use thread_get) or renaming (use thread_rename).
NEXT: thread_get to read the updated snapshot; error_explain for attachment/file codes (allnighter://errors/*).
mcpTools.title: Send to thread

mcpTools.name: thread_get

params.name: attachmentId
params.summary: Fetch one attachment by id (absorbs thread_attachment_get).

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Fetch a work thread snapshot, status/attention, or one attachment (absorbs thread_status, thread_attachment_get).
USE WHEN: Reading thread state before/after thread_send or polling running attention.
NOT WHEN: Sending a message (use thread_send) or renaming (use thread_rename).
NEXT: thread_send to continue; run_get for linked team runs.
MODE: threadId only → snapshot incl. running/attention; attachmentId → that attachment body.
mcpTools.title: Get thread

mcpTools.name: thread_rename
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Rename a work thread (same SSOT as inbox double-click rename).
USE WHEN: User-visible thread title cleanup.
NOT WHEN: Sending messages (use thread_send) or reading state (use thread_get).
NEXT: thread_get to confirm the new title.
mcpTools.title: Rename thread

mcpTools.name: pending_list

params.name: project
params.summary: Project id or name (optional; omit for --all aggregate).

params.name: mode
params.summary: queue → render-ready armed queue bundle (absorbs pending_queue).

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior list response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: List Pending items, show one item, or render the armed queue bundle (absorbs pending_show, pending_queue).
USE WHEN: Inspecting the Pending floor before submit/run/edit.
NOT WHEN: Mutating content (use pending_edit) or arming/cancelling (use pending_update).
NEXT: pending_edit to change draft content; pending_update(submit) to arm; pending_run to execute.
MODE: pendingId → one item; mode:queue → armed-queue bundle; else paginated list (project optional).
mcpTools.title: List pending

mcpTools.name: pending_edit
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Edit a Pending/Draft item's prompt or target; Pending items return to Draft when edited.
USE WHEN: Changing what will run before arming — richer schema than pending_update.
NOT WHEN: Thin state transitions only (use pending_update) or executing (use pending_run).
NEXT: pending_update(submit) to re-arm after editing a Pending item.
mcpTools.title: Edit pending

mcpTools.name: pending_update

params.name: before
params.summary: For reorder — move before this item id.

params.name: after
params.summary: For reorder — move after this item id.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Thin Pending state transitions — arm, cancel, or reorder (absorbs pending_submit, pending_cancel, pending_reorder).
USE WHEN: Arming a draft, removing from queue, or changing queue position without editing content.
NOT WHEN: Editing prompt/worker fields (use pending_edit) or executing (use pending_run).
NEXT: pending_list(mode:queue) to verify order; pending_run when armed.
ACTION: submit → Draft to Pending; cancel → remove; reorder → before|after|position.
mcpTools.title: Update pending

mcpTools.name: pending_run
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Execute a Pending workerChat or non-mutating teamRun item; mutating execute teams stay lane-safe.
USE WHEN: Running an armed Pending item headlessly.
NOT WHEN: Editing or queue management (use pending_edit / pending_update).
NEXT: run_get or thread_get depending on item kind; project_context after mutating execute in project.
mcpTools.title: Run pending

mcpTools.name: stalled_list

params.name: project
params.summary: Project id or name (optional; absorbs project_stalled).

params.name: includeCleared
params.summary: Include cleared episodes for one project.

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior list response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: List stalled-work episodes aggregate or for one project (absorbs project_stalled).
USE WHEN: Finding work that needs user attention across projects or in one project.
NOT WHEN: Acting on an episode (use stalled_update).
NEXT: stalled_update(action:check) on the episode; ask user to wait or dismiss.
MODE: project omitted → aggregate by project; project set → that project's episodes.
mcpTools.title: List stalled work

mcpTools.name: stalled_update
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Re-observe, snooze, or dismiss a stall episode (absorbs stall_check_status, stall_keep_waiting, stall_dismiss).
USE WHEN: Recovery flow after stalled_list surfaces an episode.
NOT WHEN: Read-only stall discovery (use stalled_list).
NEXT: stalled_list to confirm cleared/snoozed state.
ACTION: check → re-observe target; wait → snooze N minutes; dismiss → user-dismiss (may resurface).
mcpTools.title: Update stalled work

mcpTools.name: project_get

params.name: project
params.summary: Project id or name — omit to list.

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Pagination cursor from a prior list response.

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: List projects or show one project with fresh root/git observation (absorbs project_list).
USE WHEN: Resolving a project id/path or enumerating projects before team_run.
NOT WHEN: Capability pack (use project_context) or worker readiness (use project_workers).
NEXT: project_context before a complex run; team_run with the resolved project.
MODE: project omitted → paginated list; project present → full record.
mcpTools.title: Get project

mcpTools.name: project_context
mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Generate the versioned project context pack — runnable teams, admission hints, workers, feature flags.
USE WHEN: Before team_run/pending_run in a project; re-fetch after mutating runs or doctor health changes.
NOT WHEN: Simple project metadata only (use project_get) or live worker probes (use project_workers(refresh:true)).
NEXT: team_start(dryRun) or team_run; also exposed as allnighter://projects/{id}/context.
mcpTools.title: Get project context

mcpTools.name: project_workers

params.name: refresh
params.summary: When true, rerun safe probes and refresh cache (absorbs project_recheck_workers).

mcpTools.summary:
DOES: Read cached per-project worker readiness, or refresh via safe probes (absorbs project_recheck_workers).
USE WHEN: Choosing a worker override or verifying readiness before execute.
NOT WHEN: Full project context pack (use project_context) — never auto-configures auth.
NEXT: team_run/worker override or doctor if refresh shows blocked sources.
MODE: refresh:false → cached read; refresh:true → driver-declared safe probes only.
mcpTools.title: Get project workers
